scene: The wooden carriage rattles upward while glowing moth-lanterns sway gently overhead.
beats: Inside lies a mechanical compass that points toward the heavens. As the doors open onto the rooftop, it clicks excitedly.
You tighten a loose valve, earning a warm grin and a shiny brass comet token just as the car stops at the rooftop.
A starry messenger bird hops out and drops a folded constellation chart into your palm before flying out onto the open deck.
picture: A flat side view inside the rising funicular carriage. On the left, an open bench holds a small velvet case. The player stands left-of-centre in his orange corduroy jacket. In the centre, the conductor fiddles with a brass gear pedestal. On the right, a sleepy passenger sits above a rustling woven basket.
shown: a tiny latched velvet case sitting on an empty wooden bench on the left
a uniformed conductor adjusting glowing brass gears at the control pedestal in the centre
a woven pigeon basket trembling softly beneath a passenger's seat on the right
